gold_note: Tyrannosauroid time tree, read by eye with the tyrannosaurid part at 2x. Five names joined by arrows to the tree are kept as internal labels on the node each arrow's stem leads to: Coelurosauria and Tyrannosauroidea, and the three character-list headings Tyrannosauridae, Tyrannosaurinae and 'Derived tyrannosaurines' (as printed). Polytomies: the root (five), a seven-way node (Iliosuchus to Cf. Alectrosaurus and the tyrannosaurid branch) and a five-way node (Dryptosaurus, Appalachiosaurus, Alioramus, Bistahieversor and Tyrannosauridae). 25 tips, 3 polytomies (5, 7, 5 children); 5 printed clade names kept as internal node labels.
